versions.content: Semantics of DiagnosticEnvDataElementCondition The meta-class DiagnosticEnvDataElementCondition represents an atomic con- dition that compares the current value of the referenced DataPrototype with a constant value defined by the ValueSpecification aggregated in the role com- pareValue .
